FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 259
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Margie Wilcox
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/11/2023
House Bill 259 as introduced could increase or decrease ad valoem tax receipts to the State
General Fund, Public School Fund, Veterans Assistance Fund, and county and municipal funds
by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference in fair market value assessed by the
county for industrial development property and the amount otherwise assessed.
